name: gron
description: Make JSON greppable by flattening into discrete key-value assignments - perfect for exploring APIs and searching complex JSON structures

gron.description: Transform JSON into greppable discrete assignments for easier searching - flattens hierarchical JSON into simple key-value pairs with full path context
gron.usage:
curl api.com/data | gron # Flatten API response for grepping
gron data.json | grep 'user' # Search for user-related fields
echo '{"users":[{"name":"John"}]}' | gron | grep name # Find name fields
gron data.json | grep price | gron --ungron # Extract and reconstruct price data
